decision.scope: A RELEASE decision means the checks above passed on the candidate commit. It is not a full replication of the benchmark: the confirmatory holdouts are not rerun (they were run once, sealed), live model runs are small and sampled, and passing smoke and scripted checks shows the harness and published analyses reproduce, not that a new live study would give the same rates.
